text.text_excerpt: After my first visit I wrote:"This is going to be my new Go-To place for oysters in Mid-City. We had a dozen raw last weekend which were the cleanest oysters I have had in quite some time. We also had a fried shrimp and catfish platter that was big enough to split.The outdoor seating was a lovely place to enjoy the fresh air on a beautiful day." We had a late lunch today with some friends and was able to explore some more of the menu. It was a nice enough day to sit outside again, and the oysters were big and clean and tasty again. My friends enjoyed their entrees of Fried Chicken ($15), a soft-shelled crab special with crawfish ettouffee on top ($27), a cup of seafood gumbo ($7) and a si...

If you're in New Orleans, you've got to go to Mr. Ed's in Mid-City. They have a seafood nachos appetizer that is a MUST try. It fed all four of us and we struggled to finish it, it was huge They have a large choice of entrees. The food is so very yummy. I had the catfish platter with potato salad. The fish was fried so lightly it almost melted in my mouth and the potato salad was the perfect compliment to the fish There are dessert options and they sounded wonderful but I was so full, I couldn't even think of having dessert. The service was absolutely the best too. Karen waited on us and she was so friendly and attentive, as soon as we even thought of something we might need she was there...

Been to New Orleans so often and had wondered about this local chain, and today was the time to give Mr Ed's a go. Bottom line: I would come back, if only for the charbroiled oysters. Better IMHO than that place in Metairie. Decent bar--beer is the focus. Decent fair prices, generous servings. Shrimp po-boy was very prepared and dressed fully. The only downside was the bread, not crunchy enough, a bit too bready. The oyster spinach salad was a big hit. Lots of nicely fried oysters. So impressed with a staff working hard and coping well with the holiday lunch crowd, when they were clearly short staffed. Hey folks give your servers a break and a good tip.
